display_title: How I Ended up With a Psycho
description:
“There's exactly two things I'm curious about.”     
“W-what are they?”    
“Our chemistry in bed. And where the bedroom is. That's all I need to know.”

It didn't take long to realize. Picking him up wasn't some harmless move. It was a deadly mistake where he'd strip me down to the bone and devour me.

“I've never seen such pretty soft flesh before. I probably saw plenty of it before I lost my memory though.”

The one I picked up wasn't my first love.

“I'm going to make a mess of you. I was planning to from the start anyway.”

He was a raw, unhinged guy with a devil's horn between his legs.

(Cr TL: Gourmet Scans)
